changes: Accumulate independent task range copies and sort/compact once per combined group rather than repeatedly merging the growing result.
Compact the owned range array in place; preserve input task order and existing single-task range semantics.

edge_cases: existing grouping/version separation and aggregate fixtures

tradeoffs: Collected range storage is proportional to total input ranges until compaction. Heavily overlapping inputs may retain more intermediate ranges than incremental compaction.
Grouping key/directory/range allocation admission remains open; this change addresses repeated whole-state work, not the complete grouping memory contract.
remaining: Admit grouping topology and key construction under the task execution budget.
Validate mixed-job 64/128 MiB operation and refresh complete release gates.
